text:
You want to grow Pinterest traffic to your Etsy items and blog posts. I’m Mina Castellan, and I’d love to help you turn Pinterest into a stronger traffic source.

I bring 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, and data visualization, with skills in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, and data cleaning. While my background is analytical, that strength helps me identify what content and channels are actually driving traffic and engagement.

In a recent project for Verdant Skincare, I built a marketing attribution analysis by joining ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery and comparing first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. That work helped reallocate 18% of ad budget and brought CAC down 12% the next quarter.

If you’d like, I can help you approach Pinterest with a more data-driven strategy for your products and content.
